title: PCA three ways
brief: Compute PCA through the SVD, verify it against the Eckart-Young bound, find the top eigenvector by power iteration, and fit probabilistic PCA by EM.
hints: center returns both the centred data and the mean vector you subtracted; reconstruct needs the mean back to undo centring.
pca_svd should call numpy.linalg.svd(Xc, full_matrices=False) on the centred data, take the first k columns of V^T transposed as components, and use explained_variance = s[:k]**2 / (n - 1).
reconstruct is one line: mean + scores @ components.T.
power_iteration needs no randomness: start from a fixed vector such as ones(d) / sqrt(d), and repeat v = A @ v; v = v / norm(v).
ppca_em's E-step needs M = W.T @ W + sigma2 * I(k) inverted once per iteration; vectorize E[z_i] for all i as Xc @ W @ inv(M), and sum E[z_i z_i^T] over i as n * sigma2 * inv(M) + Ez.T @ Ez.
